tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/compression.md <<'EOF'
# Transport compression

No decision on the transport compression codec is currently recorded for this project. No codec has been chosen or ruled out, so this document does not name a value; one will be added here once a decision is recorded.
EOF
cat docs/policies/compression.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/compression.md`. It says that no decision on the transport compression codec is currently recorded, and it names no codec.

The Muninn catalog has no compression decision, and `muninn why` reported that nothing answers the question at trust 2 or above. The only compression-related records are two bare episodes, "gzip" (#2) and "zstd" (#3). Each is a one-word message with a generic acknowledgement, and neither states a decision. I didn't treat either as the project's choice.
